description: Defines the slide::Status enum class for error codes and related utility functions, including message retrieval and status checks.

classes.name: slide::Status
classes.description: Enumeration of various status/error codes related to system operation and safety.

methods.name: getStatusMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable message corresponding to a given Status enum value.

methods.name: isStatusSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates success.

methods.name: isStatusFailed
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates failure.

methods.name: isStatusOK
methods.description: Checks if the status is within acceptable limits (less than Critical).

methods.name: isStatusBad
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates a bad or problematic state.

methods.name: isStatusWarning
methods.description: Checks if the status is a warning (not success but voltage within limits).

methods.name: isStatusSafe
methods.description: Checks if the status is considered safe (less than NotSafe).

methods.name: isLimitsReached
methods.description: Checks if a limit has been reached based on status.

methods.name: isStatusVoltageLimitsViolated
methods.description: Checks if voltage limits are violated.

methods.name: isCCLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if charge/charge current limit is reached.

methods.name: isCVLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if voltage/current limit is reached.

methods.name: isCurrentLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if current limit is reached.

methods.name: isVoltageLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if voltage limit is reached.
